notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - Version 1.0.05
notes.content:
Fixed an issue with waves no longer spawning after you had triggered all of the random encounters during a run

Fixed an issue with "Upgrades drop less but last longer" and "Upgrades drop more but last less" not behaving as expected

Minor tweaks to Boss introduction flow

Fixed some layout issues on the Game Over UI

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - Version 1.0.04
notes.content:
Maxing out a stat using an ultra upgrade will correctly fill the graph bar now

Permanently firing cannons will correctly trigger during the Gorlok Boss fight

Improvements to Game Over and Rollover Rewards flow

Ship upgrade stats will now correctly reset in full on a new run

Improvements to X'akil Boss Fight weapon patterns

Increased threshold to trigger a maximum score multiplier invincibility state

Player ships will now spin out of control when a Boss scream resets their position

Improved UX when app loses and regains focus during a boss cutscene or at the ship upgrade screen

Improvements to the way asteroids split into pieces

Balancing changes to X'akil boss fight

Major fixes and improvements to control rebinding

Improvements to background assets generation

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes - Version 1.0.03
notes.content:
Demo patch notes Version 1.0.01
Player ship should no longer be frozen on game start if you exited a previous game during a respawn sequence,

Demo should no longer freeze after you defeat both bosses,

The enclosing walls should no longer de-spawn prematurely causing a soft lock


Demo patch notes Version 1.0.02
asteroids and enemies should no longer get into a stuck state whereby they don't move,

using the Rebirth upgrade will now correctly disable depth of field blur,

the Rebirth upgrade will no longer trigger every game after you acquire it,

starting rewards will now displaying the correct icon and/or description text,

your ship's stats will correctly reset to default at the start of a new game now,

enemy sauces with dual or triple fire weapons will correctly face the player before firing now,

enemies can no longer fire their weapons when they're not visible on the screen


Demo patch notes Version 1.0.03 (Current live version)
some text that was missing when choosing a different language will now be visible again,

split pieces of asteroids will no longer travel directly towards the player,

the supernova upgrade is rarer now and user control returns more swiftly,

the widespan blast weapon upgrade is rarer and doesn't last as long,

bosses will no longer spawn weapon patterns after they have been killed,

greatly reduced the volume of the intro digiggle logo sfx,

reduced the fire rate of enemies and lowered the health of the heavy-enemies to reduce random encounter difficulty,

resetting graphics settings will now correctly set the screen resolution to default
